answer_1.quote: We collect human completions of our fragments on Mechanical Turk, to evaluate performance and for fine-grained comparison of human and model behavior. ... Human raters were presented with the fragmentary input together with a completion and asked to judge the grammaticality, coherence, interestingness, and overall quality of the presented completion.

answer_2.quote: We express these tree patterns using the Tregex tool, compute the average rate of hitting the desired syntactic patterns out of the 35 completions ... and average across all the stimuli in a test as the final accuracy score for that test. ... We evaluate the performance of a model by its mean squared error (MSE) against human relative frequencies of the five syntactic category types.

answer_4.guideline: Human raters were asked to judge the grammaticality, coherence, interestingness, and overall quality of each completion.
